storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: In Terminal 1, the left-luggage facility is opposite Gate 6 in the departures hall and is open from 07:00 to 20:30, subject to actual operating hours on site. Baggage can be stored for a fee for up to 1 month. Passengers whose passports qualify for 240-hour visa-free transit can store 1 piece of baggage free for 72 hours. A valid document is required to deposit and collect baggage; items undergo X-ray screening.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: In Terminal 1, children’s play areas are on the departures level: near gate T10 in the area for international, Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan flights, and near gate T26 in the domestic area. Their opening hours follow the departing flight schedule.
